views.svgcontent: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1024" height="768"><rect x="0" y="0" width="1024" height="768" fill="#0b1220"/><text x="40" y="64" fill="#e6eeff" font-size="30" font-family="Arial">FUXA ↔ OpenPLC BOOL Test</text><text x="40" y="108" fill="#9fb6d9" font-size="20" font-family="Arial">Device: openplc:502 | Tag: SWITCH (coil 1)</text><rect x="40" y="146" width="944" height="220" rx="8" fill="#101a2d" stroke="#314460"/><text x="64" y="194" fill="#d7e5ff" font-size="22" font-family="Arial">Goal</text><text x="64" y="232" fill="#9fb6d9" font-size="18" font-family="Arial">Toggle one BOOL from FUXA and observe QX0.0 in OpenPLC, and vice versa.</text><text x="64" y="266" fill="#9fb6d9" font-size="18" font-family="Arial">Use FUXA editor to bind one switch widget to tag SWITCH.</text></svg>
